name: Remote
summary: Remote employs your hires through entities it owns in 90+ countries and runs payroll in-house. The employer of record plan starts at $599 per employee per month on an annual contract, with no setup fee and no standard deposit.

evidence.capability: employment in countries without an entity

facts.text: Remote says it is an employer of record in 90+ countries with 100+ entities that it owns and operates.
Remote states that onboarding averages 3 days and that payroll accuracy is 99% across every run.
Remote charges no standard deposit, but it may ask for a refundable reserve in some cases and says the amount is disclosed before payment.
Remote sets one exchange rate per monthly billing cycle when billing and payroll currencies differ, and says the rate is locked for that cycle.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: Starting price for annual contracts. No setup or onboarding fee, and the platform has no base fee

plans.name: Employer of Record equity add-on
plans.notes: Charged on top of the base fee

hiddenCosts: The $599 rate is for annual contracts, so it is not a month-to-month price.
A refundable reserve may be required in some cases, with the amount confirmed during onboarding.
